intro: 只含一个（或可以合并成一个）储能元件的电路是**一阶电路**，描述它的是一阶微分方程。在直流（或阶跃）激励下，任何一个电压、电流都可以用**三要素法**一步写出：f(t) = f(∞) + [f(0₊) − f(∞)]e^{−t/τ}。这一章的题目，几乎都是在求这三个要素。

en.intro: A circuit with one storage element (or several that combine into one) is a **first-order circuit**, described by a first-order differential equation. Under DC (or step) excitation every voltage and current follows from the **three-element method** in one line: f(t) = f(∞) + [f(0+) − f(∞)]e^{−t/τ}. Almost every problem in this chapter is about finding those three elements.

ideas.title: 初始值 f(0₊)：换路定则 + 0₊ 等效电路
text: 1. 由换路**前**的电路（一般是直流稳态：电容开路、电感短路）求 u_C(0₋)、i_L(0₋)；
3. 画换路**后**的 0₊ 等效电路：电容换成电压源 u_C(0₊)，电感换成电流源 i_L(0₊)，求所要的量。
电阻电流、结点电位、i_C、u_L 都可能在换路时跳变，它们的 f(0₊) **必须**从 0₊ 等效电路求，不能用 0₋ 的值。

en.title: Initial value f(0+): switching laws + the 0+ equivalent circuit
text: 1. From the circuit **before** switching (usually DC steady state: capacitor open, inductor short) find u_C(0−), i_L(0−);
2. Switching laws: u_C(0+) = u_C(0−), i_L(0+) = i_L(0−);
3. Draw the 0+ equivalent circuit **after** switching: capacitor → voltage source u_C(0+), inductor → current source i_L(0+); solve it for the quantity you need.
Resistor currents, node potentials, i_C and u_L may all jump at switching: their f(0+) **must** come from the 0+ circuit, never from the 0− values.

ideas.title: 零输入响应：RC 放电、RL 磁场能量释放
text: 换路后电路中没有独立源，响应完全由初始储能引起，称为**零输入响应**：每一个电压、电流都按同一个指数规律衰减到零，f(t) = f(0₊)e^{−t/τ}（t > 0）。
RC 放电时 u_C 从 u_C(0₊) 衰减；RL 电路断开电源后 i_L 从 i_L(0₊) 衰减，电感电压可能远高于原来的电源电压。初始储能最终全部消耗在电阻上。
t = τ 时衰减到初值的 36.8%（充电时达到终值的 63.2%）；工程上认为 3τ～5τ 后过渡过程结束。

en.title: Zero-input response: RC discharge, RL energy release
text: With no independent source after switching, the response is caused only by the initial stored energy — the **zero-input response**: every voltage and current decays to zero with the same exponential, f(t) = f(0+)e^{−t/τ} (t > 0).

In an RC discharge u_C decays from u_C(0+); when an RL circuit is cut off from its source i_L decays from i_L(0+), and the inductor voltage can be far higher than the old source voltage. All the initial energy ends up dissipated in the resistors.
At t = τ a decay is down to 36.8 % of its initial value (a charge has reached 63.2 % of its final value); in practice the transient is over after 3τ–5τ.

ideas.title: 零状态响应：RC 充电、RL 电流建立
text: 储能元件初始状态为零（u_C(0₋) = 0 或 i_L(0₋) = 0），响应完全由换路后的激励引起，称为**零状态响应**。直流激励下 u_C、i_L 从零按 1 − e^{−t/τ} 上升到稳态值：u_C(t) = u_C(∞)(1 − e^{−t/τ})，i_L(t) = i_L(∞)(1 − e^{−t/τ})。
储能元件以外的电路复杂时，先求从储能元件看进去的**戴维宁等效电路**（U_oc、R_eq），电路就化成一个电源、一个电阻、一个储能元件的简单回路。
含理想运放的一阶电路也一样：先用虚短、虚断看清储能元件所在的支路是被什么驱动的，再用三要素法。

en.title: Zero-state response: RC charging, RL current build-up
text: With zero initial state (u_C(0−) = 0 or i_L(0−) = 0) the response is caused only by the excitation after switching — the **zero-state response**. Under DC excitation u_C and i_L rise from zero as 1 − e^{−t/τ} to their steady-state values: u_C(t) = u_C(∞)(1 − e^{−t/τ}), i_L(t) = i_L(∞)(1 − e^{−t/τ}).

If the rest of the circuit is complicated, first find its **Thévenin equivalent** seen from the storage element (U_oc, R_eq): the circuit becomes a single loop of one source, one resistor and the storage element.
First-order circuits with ideal op-amps work the same way: use virtual short and virtual open to see what drives the branch with the storage element, then apply the three-element method.

ideas.title: 时间常数 τ：从储能元件看进去的等效电阻
text: τ = R_eqC（RC 电路）或 τ = L/R_eq（RL 电路），R_eq 是**换路后**的电路中，从储能元件两端看进去的戴维宁等效电阻：独立电压源短路、独立电流源开路。
同一个一阶电路中所有电压、电流的 τ 都相同。几个电容并联（或电感串联）可以合并成一个储能元件；两个电容经电阻串成回路时，对电阻而言它们是串联的，C = C_1C_2/(C_1 + C_2)。
τ 只取决于换路后的电路结构和参数，与激励、初始值无关。

en.title: Time constant τ: the equivalent resistance seen from the storage element
text: τ = R_eqC (RC circuits) or τ = L/R_eq (RL circuits), where R_eq is the Thévenin resistance of the circuit **after** switching, seen from the terminals of the storage element, with independent voltage sources shorted and independent current sources opened.

Every voltage and current of one first-order circuit has the same τ. Capacitors in parallel (or inductors in series) merge into one storage element; two capacitors joined in a loop through a resistor are in series as seen by the resistor, C = C_1C_2/(C_1 + C_2).
τ depends only on the circuit after switching and its parameters, not on the excitation or the initial values.

ideas.title: 含受控源时求 R_eq：外加电源法
text: 受控源**不能置零**，也不能直接用串并联化简。方法：独立源置零，在储能元件的位置加电压 u（或电流 i），求流入的电流 i（或端电压 u），R_eq = u/i。也可以用 R_eq = U_oc/I_sc（开路电压 / 短路电流）。
受控源可能让 R_eq 变小、变大，甚至为负：R_eq < 0 时 τ < 0，响应按指数增长，电路不稳定，不存在稳态。

en.title: R_eq with dependent sources: the applied-source method
text: A dependent source **must not be zeroed** and cannot be simplified away by series/parallel rules. Method: zero the independent sources, apply a voltage u (or current i) where the storage element sits, find the current i flowing in (or the voltage u), R_eq = u/i. Alternatively R_eq = U_oc/I_sc (open-circuit voltage / short-circuit current).
A dependent source can make R_eq smaller, larger, or even negative: with R_eq < 0, τ < 0, the response grows exponentially, the circuit is unstable and has no steady state.

ideas.title: 三要素法
text: 直流激励下一阶电路的任一响应（不只是 u_C、i_L，也包括电阻电流、结点电位）都是 f(t) = f(∞) + [f(0₊) − f(∞)]e^{−t/τ}，t > 0。三个要素：
- **f(∞)**：换路后的直流稳态（电容开路、电感短路）；
- **τ**：从储能元件看进去的 R_eq。
开关可以是打开、闭合，也可以是换向开关；激励可以是电压源或电流源。先求 u_C 或 i_L 再用 KCL、KVL 推出其他量，也是常用的验算方法。

en.title: The three-element method
text: Under DC excitation any response of a first-order circuit (not only u_C and i_L, but resistor currents and node potentials too) is f(t) = f(∞) + [f(0+) − f(∞)]e^{−t/τ}, t > 0. The three elements:
- **f(0+)**: from the 0+ equivalent circuit;
- **f(∞)**: from the DC steady state after switching (capacitor open, inductor short);
- **τ**: from R_eq seen by the storage element.
The switch may open, close or change over; the excitation may be voltage or current sources. Finding u_C or i_L first and deriving the rest with KCL and KVL is also a good check.

ideas.title: 全响应的两种分解与线性
text: **全响应 = 零输入响应 + 零状态响应**（按原因分：初始储能 / 外加激励）；**全响应 = 稳态分量 + 暂态分量**（按形式分：强制分量 f(∞) / 自由分量 [f(0₊) − f(∞)]e^{−t/τ}）。两种写法加起来相同。
零状态响应对**每个激励**是线性的（激励加倍、响应加倍；几个激励的响应可以叠加）；零输入响应与初始状态成正比。全响应对激励**不**成正比，除非把初始状态也看成一种激励。

en.title: Two ways to split the complete response; linearity
text: **Complete response = zero-input + zero-state** (split by cause: initial energy / applied excitation); **complete response = steady-state + transient** (split by form: forced part f(∞) / natural part [f(0+) − f(∞)]e^{−t/τ}). Both add up to the same thing.

The zero-state response is linear in **each excitation** (double the source, double the response; responses to several sources superpose); the zero-input response is proportional to the initial state. The complete response is **not** proportional to the excitation unless the initial state is also treated as an excitation.

ideas.title: 阶跃响应
text: 单位阶跃函数 ε(t)：t < 0 为 0，t > 0 为 1。用它可以把“开关在 t = 0 接通”写成激励 u_s = U_sε(t)；延时接通写成 ε(t − t_0)。
**单位阶跃响应** s(t) 是激励为 ε(t) 时的零状态响应；激励为 Aε(t) 时零状态响应为 As(t)。写响应时乘上 ε(t) 表示它只在 t > 0 成立。
激励写成 u_s = U_1 + U_2ε(t) 时，t < 0 的稳态由 U_1 决定，初始状态**不为零**：响应 = U_1 产生的原稳态 + U_2ε(t) 产生的零状态响应（或直接用三要素法）。

en.title: Step response
text: The unit step ε(t) is 0 for t < 0 and 1 for t > 0. It turns “switched on at t = 0” into an excitation u_s = U_sε(t); a delayed switch-on is ε(t − t_0).
The **unit step response** s(t) is the zero-state response to ε(t); for Aε(t) the zero-state response is As(t). Multiplying a response by ε(t) says it holds for t > 0 only.

For an excitation u_s = U_1 + U_2ε(t), the steady state for t < 0 is set by U_1, so the initial state is **not zero**: response = the old steady state due to U_1 + the zero-state response to U_2ε(t) (or just use the three-element method).

ideas.title: 正弦激励下的一阶电路
text: 正弦激励下电路没有 f(∞)，三要素法中的 f(∞) 换成**稳态解** f_p(t)（用相量法求出的正弦量）：f(t) = f_p(t) + [f(0₊) − f_p(0₊)]e^{−t/τ}。
自由分量的大小取决于合闸时刻（初相位）：若 f_p(0₊) = f(0₊)，合闸后立即进入稳态，没有过渡过程；相差最大时过渡过程最剧烈。
正弦量以 cos 为参考：题目给 sin 时先换成 cos(x − 90°)。

en.title: First-order circuits with sinusoidal excitation
text: With a sinusoidal source there is no f(∞); replace it by the **steady-state solution** f_p(t) (the sinusoid found by the phasor method): f(t) = f_p(t) + [f(0+) − f_p(0+)]e^{−t/τ}.

The size of the natural part depends on the switching instant (the initial phase): if f_p(0+) = f(0+) the circuit enters steady state at once, with no transient; the larger the mismatch, the larger the transient.
Sinusoids are referenced to cos: a sine is first rewritten as cos(x − 90°).

formulas.name: 换路定则
formulas.when: 换路瞬间 i_C、u_L 为有限值；只对这两个状态量成立，其他量的 0₊ 值由 0₊ 等效电路求。

en.name: Switching laws
en.when: i_C and u_L finite at the switching instant; holds only for these two state variables — other 0+ values come from the 0+ circuit.

formulas.name: 零输入响应
formulas.when: 换路后没有独立源；f 为电路中任一电压或电流，f(0₊) 取 0₊ 时刻的值（不是 0₋）。

en.name: Zero-input response
en.when: No independent source after switching; f is any voltage or current, f(0+) its value at 0+ (not 0−).

formulas.name: 零状态响应（直流）
formulas.when: u_C(0₋) = 0 或 i_L(0₋) = 0，换路后为直流激励；只对状态量 u_C、i_L 这样写，其他量用三要素法。

en.name: Zero-state response (DC)
en.when: u_C(0−) = 0 or i_L(0−) = 0, DC excitation after switching; this form is for the state variables u_C, i_L only — use the three-element method for the rest.

formulas.name: 时间常数
formulas.when: R_eq：换路后从储能元件两端看进去的等效电阻，独立电压源短路、独立电流源开路，受控源保留。

en.name: Time constant
en.when: R_eq: the resistance seen from the storage element's terminals after switching, independent voltage sources shorted, current sources opened, dependent sources kept.

formulas.name: 过渡过程的进度
formulas.when: 按指数规律变化的量在 t = τ、3τ、5τ 时完成的比例；工程上 3τ～5τ 视为结束。

en.name: How far the transient has gone
en.when: Fraction of an exponential change completed at t = τ, 3τ, 5τ; in practice the transient is over after 3τ–5τ.

formulas.name: 外加电源法求 R_eq
formulas.when: 独立源置零、受控源保留；u、i 对外加电源取非关联方向（i 从“+”端流入网络）。R_eq 可能为负（电路不稳定）。

en.name: R_eq by an applied source
en.when: Independent sources zeroed, dependent sources kept; i is the current the applied source drives into the network at its “+” terminal. R_eq may be negative (unstable circuit).

formulas.name: 三要素公式
formulas.when: 一阶电路，换路后为直流（含阶跃）激励；f 可以是任一电压、电流。

en.name: Three-element formula
en.when: First-order circuit with DC (or step) excitation after switching; f may be any voltage or current.

formulas.name: 全响应的分解
formulas.expr: f = f_{零输入} + f_{零状态} = f_{稳态} + f_{暂态}
formulas.when: 线性电路。零状态响应对每个激励满足叠加和齐次性；全响应只在把初始状态也当作激励时才满足。

en.name: Splitting the complete response
en.when: Linear circuits. The zero-state response obeys superposition and homogeneity in each source; the complete response only if the initial state is counted as a source.

formulas.name: 阶跃响应
formulas.expr: 激励 Aε(t) → 零状态响应 As(t)；激励 Aε(t − t_0) → As(t − t_0)
formulas.when: s(t) 为单位阶跃响应（零状态）；时不变线性电路。

en.name: Step response
en.expr: excitation Aε(t) → zero-state response As(t); Aε(t − t_0) → As(t − t_0)
en.when: s(t) is the unit step response (zero state); linear time-invariant circuit.

formulas.name: 正弦激励下的全响应
formulas.when: f_p(t) 是用相量法求得的正弦稳态解（cos 参考）；t > 0。

en.name: Complete response with a sinusoidal source
en.when: f_p(t) is the sinusoidal steady-state solution from the phasor method (cosine reference); t > 0.

examples.title: 三要素法：电容电压和一条电阻支路的电流
examples.statement: 图示电路中 u_s = 4 + 8ε(t) V（t < 0 时为 4 V，t > 0 时为 12 V），R_1 = R_2 = 4 kΩ，R_3 = 1 kΩ，C = 100 µF，t < 0 时电路已处于稳态。用三要素法求 u_C(t) 和 R_3 中的电流 i_3(t)，并求 t = 0.3 s 时的值。
steps: 4. **τ。** u_s 短路，从电容两端看进去：R_eq = R_3 + R_1 ∥ R_2 = **3 kΩ**，τ = R_eqC = **0.3 s**。

en.title: Three-element method: a capacitor voltage and a resistor current
en.statement: In the circuit u_s = 4 + 8ε(t) V (4 V for t < 0, 12 V for t > 0), R_1 = R_2 = 4 kΩ, R_3 = 1 kΩ, C = 100 µF; for t < 0 the circuit is in steady state. Use the three-element method to find u_C(t) and the current i_3(t) in R_3, and their values at t = 0.3 s.
steps: 1. **Steady state for t < 0 (u_s = 4 V).** Capacitor open, no current in R_3: u_C(0−) = u_a = 4 × R_2/(R_1 + R_2) = **2 V**.

2. **f(0+).** Switching law: u_C(0+) = 2 V. 0+ circuit: u_s = 12 V, capacitor replaced by a 2 V source. Node a: (12 − u_a)/4 = u_a/4 + (u_a − 2)/1 (kΩ, mA) → **u_a(0+) = 3.333 V**, **i_3(0+) = (3.333 − 2)/1k = 1.333 mA** (i_3 jumps from 0).
4. **τ.** Short u_s and look in from the capacitor terminals: R_eq = R_3 + R_1 ∥ R_2 = **3 kΩ**, τ = R_eqC = **0.3 s**.
**Check:** i_3 = i_C = C du_C/dt = 100×10⁻⁶ × (4/0.3)e^{−t/0.3}, which at t = 0+ is exactly 1.333 mA ✓.

examples.title: 含 CCVS 的 RL 电路：受控源改变了 τ
examples.statement: 图示电路中 u_s = 12ε(t) V，R_1 = R_2 = 4 Ω，L = 0.5 H，电感原来没有电流。电流控制电压源 H 的电压为 2i_2（“+”在左），i_2 为 R_2 中向下的电流。求 R_eq、τ、u_a(0₊)、i_2(0₊)、u_L(0₊)、i_L(∞)，以及 t = 0.5 s 时的 i_L。
steps: 1. **R_eq（外加电源法）。** u_s 短路，在 b 与地之间加电压 u，设从 b 流入网络的电流为 i。KVL 经 H：u_b = u_a − 2i_2，而 i_2 = u_a/R_2 = u_a/4，所以 u = u_a/2，即 u_a = 2u。结点 a 的 KCL：i = u_a/R_1 + u_a/R_2 = 2u/4 + 2u/4 = u，**R_eq = 1 Ω**。
如果把受控源置零，会得到 R_1 ∥ R_2 = 2 Ω——错误，τ 会算成原来的一半。

en.title: RL circuit with a CCVS: the dependent source changes τ
en.statement: In the circuit u_s = 12ε(t) V, R_1 = R_2 = 4 Ω, L = 0.5 H, with no initial inductor current. The current-controlled voltage source H has voltage 2i_2 (“+” on the left), i_2 being the downward current in R_2. Find R_eq, τ, u_a(0+), i_2(0+), u_L(0+), i_L(∞) and i_L at t = 0.5 s.
steps: 1. **R_eq (applied source).** Short u_s, apply a voltage u between b and ground and let i be the current it drives into b. KVL through H: u_b = u_a − 2i_2 with i_2 = u_a/R_2 = u_a/4, so u = u_a/2, i.e. u_a = 2u. KCL at a: i = u_a/R_1 + u_a/R_2 = 2u/4 + 2u/4 = u, so **R_eq = 1 Ω**.
Zeroing the dependent source would give R_1 ∥ R_2 = 2 Ω — wrong, and τ would come out half its true value.
3. **0+ equivalent circuit.** i_L(0+) = i_L(0−) = 0: the inductor is open, R_1 and R_2 in series: **u_a(0+) = 6 V**, **i_2(0+) = 1.5 A**, H's voltage 2i_2 = 3, so **u_L(0+) = u_b = 6 − 3 = 3 V**.
4. **i_L(∞).** Inductor short: u_b = 0 = u_a − 2i_2 = u_a − u_a/2, so u_a = 0, i_2 = 0 and all the current flows through R_1: **i_L(∞) = 12/4 = 3 A**.

mistakes.text: 三要素法里把电阻电流、i_C、u_L 的 f(0₋) 当成 f(0₊)。只有 u_C、i_L 连续，其他量的初值必须从 0₊ 等效电路求。

en.text: Using f(0−) for a resistor current, i_C or u_L in the three-element method. Only u_C and i_L are continuous; every other initial value must come from the 0+ circuit.

mistakes.text: 求 R_eq 时没有把独立源置零（电压源短路、电流源开路），或者用换路**前**的电路求 τ。τ 由换路后的电路决定。

en.text: Not zeroing the independent sources (voltage sources shorted, current sources opened) when finding R_eq, or finding τ from the circuit **before** switching. τ belongs to the circuit after switching.

mistakes.text: 把受控源也“置零”后用串并联求 R_eq。受控源必须保留，用外加电源法或 U_oc/I_sc。

en.text: “Zeroing” the dependent source too and then combining resistors. Keep dependent sources and use an applied source or U_oc/I_sc.

mistakes.text: RL 电路写成 τ = RL 或 τ = R/L。正确的是 τ = L/R_eq（单位 H/Ω = s）；R 越大，RL 电路衰减越快，RC 电路却越慢。

en.text: Writing τ = RL or τ = R/L for an RL circuit. It is τ = L/R_eq (H/Ω = s); a larger R makes an RL circuit faster but an RC circuit slower.

mistakes.text: 看到 ε(t) 就以为初始状态为零。激励是 U_1 + U_2ε(t) 时，t < 0 已经有 U_1 作用，初始值要按 U_1 的稳态算。

en.text: Assuming zero initial state whenever ε(t) appears. With U_1 + U_2ε(t), U_1 already acts for t < 0, so the initial values come from its steady state.

mistakes.text: 正弦激励下仍去求 f(∞)。正弦稳态没有终值，要用稳态解 f_p(t) 和它在 0₊ 的值 f_p(0₊)。

en.text: Looking for f(∞) with a sinusoidal source. There is no final value; use the steady-state solution f_p(t) and its value f_p(0+).

mistakes.text: 电路里有两个储能元件就不敢用三要素法。并联的电容（串联的电感）能合并成一个，经电阻串成回路的两个电容对电阻也是一个等效电容；只有不能合并时才是二阶电路。

en.text: Avoiding the three-element method because there are two storage elements. Parallel capacitors (series inductors) merge into one, and two capacitors in a loop with a resistor form one equivalent capacitor for that resistor; only elements that cannot be merged make a second-order circuit.
